captions.detailed: A compact retractable mirrorless camera zoom lens with a dark matte black finish and a metallic silver rear mount. It features a short outer lens barrel, a ribbed zoom ring, a coaxial unlock ring, and a front barrel section terminating in a dark glass optical element. The unlock ring and zoom ring rotate continuously around the optical axis, while the front barrel section translates linearly along the axis when extending or retracting.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact retractable mirrorless camera zoom lens. The model should include a silver-colored rear mount, a matte black outer barrel, a ribbed zoom ring, an unlock ring, and an extendable front barrel with a dark glass lens element. Define continuous rotational joints for the rings and a prismatic translation joint along the lens axis for the extending front barrel.
captions.factory: Construct the lens using coaxial cylinder primitives of varying radii and heights to form the outer barrel, zoom ring, unlock ring, and inner front barrel. Create the glass optics and rear mount using thin cylindrical discs. Assemble the components by defining a 'fixed' base link for the rear mount and outer barrel, 'continuous' rotational joints for the zoom and unlock rings, and a 'prismatic' joint for the front barrel's axial extension.
